value.rationale: A complete continuously parametrized natural binary-Gaussian location-mixture family is classified exactly up to its maximal log-concave boundary. The proof identifies a structural weighted-hyperbolic inequality resolving the nontrivial sign term in an open symmetric entropy-geometry setting and gives the exact fourth-order nonequilibrium curvature onset. It does not claim a full all-t theorem or solve the broad conjecture.
